description: Run your law firm's Smokeball from workflows: open and update matters, add contacts, tasks, memos, time entries, expenses and calendar events. Start a workflow when a matter is opened or changed, a contact is added or changed, or a task is added or completed.

smokeball_contact_changed_trigger.description: Runs when a person or company is added to your contacts, or changed. Smokeball doesn't say which, so both start it.

output.contact: Everything Smokeball says about the contact
output.contact_id: The contact's ID, for the contact actions
output.name: Their name

smokeball_matter_updated_trigger.description: Runs each time a matter is changed, such as its status, staff or description. Opening a matter starts it too.

output.matter: Everything Smokeball says about the matter
output.matter_id: The matter's ID, for the matter actions
output.status: Open, Pending, Closed, Canceled or Deleted
output.title: Its title

parameters.description: Only matters of this type. Leave blank for every type.
parameters.name: matter_type_id

smokeball_new_matter_trigger.description: Runs when a matter is opened in Smokeball. Matters already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.matter: Everything Smokeball says about the matter
output.matter_id: The matter's ID, for the matter actions
output.status: Open, Pending, Closed, Canceled or Deleted
output.title: Its title

parameters.description: Only matters of this type. Leave blank for every type.
parameters.name: matter_type_id

smokeball_new_memo_trigger.description: Runs when a memo (file note) is added to a matter.

output.memo: Everything Smokeball says about the memo
output.title: Its title

parameters.description: The matter to watch.
parameters.name: matter_id

smokeball_new_task_trigger.description: Runs when a task is added, on any matter or on the one you pick.

output.matter_id: The matter it is on, if any
output.subject: What the task is
output.task: Everything Smokeball says about the task
output.task_id: The task's ID, for the task actions

parameters.description: Only tasks on this matter. Leave blank for every matter.
parameters.name: matter_id

smokeball_new_time_entry_trigger.description: Runs when time is recorded on a matter.

output.subject: What the work was
